title: Smart Swarm / Distributed visual stories
operator_action: Use existing native controls. Begin each source only from the verified stationary setup.
placement_regions: Use the marked cube origin inside SO101's attended reach envelope.
Use the taped accessible placement box, checked with both cameras before recording.
Use marked carrier destinations left and right from ROSMASTER's viewpoint. Keep both out of SO101's motion envelope during relocation.

F1.placement: Place the cube in the accessible marked carrier. Lift, release and withdraw on the native controls.
F1.relocation: Move the carrier to the assigned ROSMASTER-side station while Tank watches the exterior. Record who moved it.
F1.withheld: Neither SO101 nor ROSMASTER sees Tank's relocation interval.

F2.placement: Perform a safe placement attempt that leaves the cube on the marked surface, then withdraw and preserve that outcome.
F2.relocation: Move the empty carrier while Tank watches. Leave the cube where it actually rested.
F2.withheld: Tank's exterior view does not reveal the cube's final surface position.

F3.placement: Record a successful insertion, then remove the cube to the declared accessible surface mark while SO101 still witnesses the change. Log human assistance if used.
F3.relocation: Move the original carrier only after the second content event ends.
F3.withheld: Tank and ROSMASTER do not witness the removal.

F4.placement: Place the cube into one of two same-looking bins. Preserve anonymous visual tracks and keep the evaluator identity mapping private.
F4.relocation: Move identical exteriors past each other or behind an external shield while Tank sees only the declared partial interval.
F4.withheld: Never put hidden identity, mark or crossing truth in a runtime message.

F5.task: Carrier nested in a larger tray
F5.placement: Place the cube into the reachable small carrier. Confirm the outer tray clearance before starting.
F5.relocation: After SO101 is parked, put the entire small carrier in the outer tray while Tank observes their exterior relation. Record human assistance when used.
F5.withheld: Tank sees the nesting and relocation of the carrier; it has no view of the cube itself.

F6.placement: Record matched setup and approach. Keep the decisive insertion or failed outcome out of the granted SO101 clip and any transmitted command or metadata.
F6.relocation: Use the same declared exterior path and Tank view schedule across the paired outcomes.
F6.withheld: Withhold the decisive visual, state and message windows for all agents. Score the separate resolvable F1 or F2 control in the same block.
